prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished grounded fantasy RPG inventory icon, readable at 48 pixels. One isolated fish item, three-quarter side product view, head to left and tail to right with slight diagonal. Centered occupying 80 percent of square canvas. Believable three-dimensional volume and rich physically grounded material shading, broad clear silhouette, soft studio light from upper left. Actual transparent background with true alpha channel, no backdrop, floor, shadow outside object, plate, garnish, utensils, text, labels, border, or tile. No cartoon outline, flat silhouette or crude geometric rendering. Subject: Minnow, a palm-sized small slender freshwater fish from river shallows. One whole fresh silver minnow, narrow torpedo body, tiny delicate fins and forked tail, silvery blue-grey scaled back and pale belly, small clean head and round eye. No bass-like heavy jaw, no spiny dorsal.
Revision prompt: Edit this image: retain the single minnow exactly but remove ALL background and the entire pale glowing halo. Deliver a clean isolated fish cutout on genuinely transparent alpha background, no mist, no glow, no shadow outside fish, square canvas. Preserve delicate fins, body and fish surface quality. Fish only; all pixels outside fish must be fully transparent.
sourceLookup: Existing genuine fish_minnow GLB was rendered with improved shading and reviewed by final fresh Luna max critic. It remained flat and low detail at inventory size and was rejected; no suitable higher quality single Minnow 3D source available.
review: Root accepted after fresh Luna max critic approved source and 48px readability. All nine fish passed production inventory lab: loaded 48px rasters, no SVG fallback, matching hover, no errors. Root inspected lab screenshot. Evidence: test-results/icon-fish-final/lab-icons.json and test-results/icon-fish-final/lab-icons.png. Accepted 2026-09-10.
